mapper.select: SELECT TIMELINE_SEQ AS timeline_seq, TIMELINE_TYPE_CD AS timeline_type_cd, TITLE AS title, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(CONTENT, 4000, 1) AS content, TO_CHAR(EVENT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS event_dt, NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') AS use_yn, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at, UPDATED_BY AS updated_by, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, CREATED_BY AS created_by FROM ADM_TIMELINE_MST WHERE TIMELINE_SEQ = #{timelineSeq}
mapper.insert:
